name: Python
author: mohamed@beyd.ca
description:
Run Python apps and Discord bots, on Python 3.11 to 3.15.

- Dependencies: requirements.txt is installed with uv into a venv, and skipped on restarts when nothing changed
- Git: clone your bot from a Git repo, optionally pulling updates on every start
- Multi-Bot Mode (set by an admin): host many bots on one server, each in its own folder with its own packages and .env, managed from a web panel on the server's port

By Rustix (rustix.xyz).

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Rustix Python installer: sets up the server's files (Git clone, or a starter bot folder).

# Bump this whenever the egg changes. Servers compare it with the egg on GitHub at
# startup and show an update notice in the console.
EGG_VERSION="1.0.0"

is_true() { [ "$1" = "1" ] || [ "$1" = "true" ]; }

# Drop user:token@ from a git URL so a changed token still counts as the same repo
strip_auth() { printf '%s' "$1" | sed -E 's#^([a-z]+://)[^/@]*@#\1#'; }

# The install container has a terminal nobody types into: never wait for a git password
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0

cd /mnt/server || exit 1
apk add --no-cache git || { echo "Failed to install git"; exit 1; }
# Server files belong to the server user, not root; let git work on them anyway
git config --global --add safe.directory '*'

# Anything here besides what the egg itself creates?
has_files() {
    [ -n "$(find . -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 ! -name .egg-version ! -name logs ! -name .cache ! -name .venv ! -name .rustix | head -n 1)" ]
}

finish() {
    mkdir -p /mnt/server/logs
    echo "${EGG_VERSION}" > /mnt/server/.egg-version
    echo "$1"
    exit 0
}

# Starter bot for multi-bot mode, so the panel has something to show. Auto-start is off.
seed_example_bot() {
    has_files && return
    mkdir -p example-bot
    cat > example-bot/bot.py <<'PY'
# Example bot: copy this folder for each bot you host. The panel runs every folder
# that has a bot.py (or main.py / app.py) in it, each with its own packages and .env.
import os
import time

print(f"example-bot running, DISCORD_TOKEN set: {bool(os.getenv('DISCORD_TOKEN'))}")
while True:
    time.sleep(60)
PY
    printf '# discord.py>=2.6\n' > example-bot/requirements.txt
    printf '# Each bot reads its own .env\nDISCORD_TOKEN=\n' > example-bot/.env
    touch example-bot/.disabled
    echo "Added example-bot/ (auto-start off). Copy it for each bot you want to host."
}

if is_true "${USER_UPLOAD}"; then
    is_true "${MULTI_BOT}" && seed_example_bot
    finish "User Uploaded Files is on, skipping Git setup. Upload your files."
fi

if [ -z "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
    is_true "${MULTI_BOT}" && seed_example_bot
    if is_true "${MULTI_BOT}"; then
        finish "Install complete. Put each bot in its own folder, then open the web panel on this server's address."
    fi
    finish "Install complete. Upload your bot (${PY_FILE:-bot.py}) and its requirements.txt."
fi

# Git
case "${GIT_ADDRESS}" in
    *.git) ;;
    *) GIT_ADDRESS="${GIT_ADDRESS}.git" ;;
esac

if [ -n "${USERNAME}" ] && [ -n "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
    GIT_ADDRESS="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@${GIT_ADDRESS#*://}"
fi

if has_files; then
    if [ -d .git ]; then
        if [ "$(strip_auth "$(git config --get remote.origin.url)")" = "$(strip_auth "${GIT_ADDRESS}")" ]; then
            echo "Pulling latest files from git"
            # Picks up a changed Git Username/Access Token
            git remote set-url origin "${GIT_ADDRESS}"
            git pull --ff-only || echo "git pull failed, keeping the current files."
        else
            echo "This server is a clone of a different git repo, leaving it alone."
        fi
    else
        echo "This server already has files that aren't from git, leaving them alone."
    fi
else
    echo "Cloning files from git"
    rm -rf /tmp/clone
    if [ -n "${BRANCH}" ]; then
        git clone --single-branch --branch "${BRANCH}" "${GIT_ADDRESS}" /tmp/clone || { echo "git clone failed, check Git Repo Address, Git Branch and credentials"; exit 1; }
    else
        git clone "${GIT_ADDRESS}" /tmp/clone || { echo "git clone failed, check Git Repo Address and credentials"; exit 1; }
    fi
    cp -a /tmp/clone/. /mnt/server/ && rm -rf /tmp/clone
fi

finish "Install complete."

variables.name: Multi-Bot Mode
variables.description:
Host several bots on this server, each in its own folder, with a web panel on the server's port to start, stop and watch them. Off runs one Python app.

Only an admin can change this.

0 = false (default)
1 = true

variables.name: Entry File
variables.description: The Python file to run (single app mode).

variables.name: Requirements File
variables.description: Installed on start when it changes (single app mode). In Multi-Bot Mode each bot uses the requirements.txt in its own folder.

variables.name: Auto Install Dependencies
variables.description:
Install the requirements file and extra packages on start. Restarts skip this when nothing changed.

0 = false
1 = true (default)

variables.name: Extra Packages
variables.description: Space separated pip packages to install on top of the requirements file, e.g. discord.py python-dotenv (single app mode).

variables.name: Custom Startup Command
variables.description: Run this instead of the Entry File, inside the app's venv, e.g. gunicorn app:app -b 0.0.0.0:$SERVER_PORT (single app mode). Leave blank to run the Entry File.

variables.name: Bot Panel Password
variables.description: Password for the Multi-Bot web panel. Leave blank to have one generated; it's shown in the console on every start.

variables.name: Bots Folder
variables.description: Folder (inside the server) that holds the bot folders in Multi-Bot Mode. Blank uses the server's main folder.

variables.name: Auto Restart Bots
variables.description:
Restart a bot that crashes in Multi-Bot Mode, waiting longer after each crash (5 seconds up to 5 minutes).

0 = false
1 = true (default)

variables.name: Git Repo Address
variables.description: Git repo to clone on install, e.g. https://github.com/you/your-bot

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: Branch to clone. Blank uses the repo's default branch.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description:
Pull the latest files from the Git repo on every start.

0 = false (default)
1 = true

variables.name: User Uploaded Files
variables.description:
Skip the Git setup, you upload the files yourself.

0 = false (default)
1 = true

variables.name: Git Username
variables.description: Username for a private Git repo.

variables.name: Git Access Token
variables.description: Access token for a private Git repo. Use a personal access token, not your password.

variables.name: Update Check
variables.description:
Check GitHub on startup and say in the console when the egg or the Docker image has an update.

0 = false
1 = true (default)
